title: Recruitment reforms: CTAN threatens agitation from Nov 30

ai.summary: CTAN warned of an agitation starting November 30 if Nagaland state government fails to respond to recruitment reforms demands by November 26, 2026.

facts.claim: CTAN warned of an agitation starting November 30 if Nagaland state government fails to respond to recruitment reforms demands by November 26, 2026.
facts.quote: Combined Technical Association of Nagaland (CTAN) has warned of an agitation from November 30 if the state government failed to respond to its demands by November 26, 2026.

ai.background_note: CTAN is a technical association in Nagaland that has been demanding recruitment reforms in the state government's hiring processes.
